title: Second Serving — Actual User Walkthrough
notes: Real user footage, edited chronologically. Waiting and repeated attempts are shortened.
Playback speed is displayed whenever a clip is accelerated.
Original audio is removed. The Chrome password warning is excluded.
This recording demonstrates a blocked transfer, not a completed delivery.
Stock quantities and route values are illustrative demo inputs, not measured impact.

clips.label: SIGN IN
clips.caption: Branch operations and incident recovery for fast-food and takeaway chains.

clips.label: SPOT THE SERVICE GAP
clips.caption: Branch A has ingredients, but equipment faults block its menu.

clips.label: DEFINE THE REQUEST
clips.caption: Define the need: five beef-rice servings for Branch A within 60 minutes.

clips.label: CHECK REAL CONSTRAINTS
clips.caption: A support branch must pass menu, stock, equipment and delivery-route checks.

clips.label: CONNECT THE BRANCHES
clips.caption: Approve a directed route from Branch B to A: 10 minutes, ¥600.

clips.label: BRANCH-OWNED INVENTORY
clips.caption: Select the ingredients stocked at Branch B. Quantities belong to each branch.

clips.label: RECEIVE AND AUDIT STOCK
clips.caption: Receive stock with a reason. The new balance and movement history are recorded.

clips.label: ASSIGN EQUIPMENT OWNERSHIP
clips.caption: Register a working fryer for Branch B, with an explicit owning branch.

clips.label: CONFIGURE LOCAL OPERATIONS
clips.caption: Choose which dishes Branch B offers and set its operating hours.

clips.label: RECALCULATE MENU READINESS
clips.caption: An additional working fryer makes Branch A's menu available. Incident history remains.

clips.label: PRESERVE INCIDENT HISTORY
clips.caption: Track operating status separately from incident history.

clips.label: NVIDIA NEMOTRON ON NEBIUS
clips.caption: Request AI advice for manager review. Operational changes still need confirmation.

clips.label: RECHECK SUPPORT AVAILABILITY
clips.caption: Branch B is still blocked: a missing griller and a dish travel limit.

clips.label: COMPLETE BRANCH EQUIPMENT
clips.caption: Add a working griller to Branch B. Equipment requirements are checked per dish.

clips.label: REPORT A NEW BRANCH INCIDENT
clips.caption: Record a fryer fault at Branch B and request four fried-chicken servings.

clips.label: SET UP THE REVERSE ROUTE
clips.caption: Approve the return direction separately: Branch A to Branch B.

clips.label: ENFORCE THE DISH TRAVEL POLICY
clips.caption: Transfer blocked: 10 minutes of travel exceeds the dish's 3-minute limit.

clips.label: A CHECKED PLAN, NOT A FALSE PROMISE
clips.caption: No eligible source means no transfer is created. Managers must review the constraints.
